rules.body: Apply when persistent document work is coalesced while a shorter-lived view owns a subscription and saving can synchronously navigate. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate." docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by the coordinator dictionary, while Badge owns only a live subscription."

Route edits through the existing document-specific trailing task. Restart its quiet interval on each edit, consume only the latest text, and keep it usable for subsequent bursts. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/services.js: "push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); },"

Preserve pending document edits when switching, closing, or disposing by flushing before departure returns. Retiring the live subscription must not discard or take ownership of the dictionary-owned buffer. This follows from TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." and docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by the coordinator dictionary, while Badge owns only a live subscription."

Publish retirement state and finish departing-view cleanup before flushing can invoke save listeners. After that callback boundary, an outer navigation must check whether a nested navigation superseded it before publishing a replacement view. docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." src/coordinator.js supplies the request guard "if(true&&mine!==request)return;". Also preserve the trailing utility's reset-before-consume ordering: src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };"

Preserve public methods, document identity and text, and status event semantics, including valid empty text. docs/host-api.md: "createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide()." and "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." src/services.js constructs "const event = {id, text, revision: ++revision};"

Do not transfer the document persistence policy to transient preview work or generalize these rules to resources with a different owner or a discard-on-departure policy. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." Preserve src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};"

Check with controlled timers that edits remain unwritten before 120 ms of quiet, only the latest text saves at the deadline, and a later burst saves again. Check pending edits across switch, close, dispose, and same-document reopening, including empty text. Exercise synchronous save listeners that open another document or close the workspace; their navigation must remain authoritative. These checks operationalize TASK's "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." and docs/host-api.md's "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." Verify preview's existing 40 ms delay, hide cancellation, and later reuse as preservation checks.

limitations: The rules derive from TASK and the supplied public sources; automatic contracts, experience guidance, AST hints, and evaluation observations do not establish requirements.
The supplied implementation does not establish synchronous subscription bootstrap or asynchronous decoding, so provisional startup handles and decoded-result authorization are outside these rules.
Throwing host callbacks and exception recovery are unspecified.
A passing example does not prove causality, exhaustive correctness, or benefit across tasks. No verification was executed and no files were modified.
